pages.text: Lower-tier scrolls have a $(term)validity period$() after activation: Transmutation and Terrestrial scrolls expire at noon each day, and Lunar scrolls at new-moon midnight. Solar and Void scrolls never expire.$(br2)An hourglass on the HUD shows the countdown to expiration.

pages.title: Mutation
pages.text: Expiration triggers a $(term)mutation$(): every slot's target essence becomes hidden again, and some targets change. You must explore the pattern anew.$(br2)For long, difficult work, choose Lunar or higher-tier scrolls.
